# ColdCaseIndex (coldcaseindex.com)

## About
ColdCaseIndex is a searchable database of 450 documented cold cases and historic
crimes in the United States — unsolved homicides, missing persons, unidentified
victims, serial-killer cases, and landmark solved crimes of historical
significance. Coverage spans all 50 states and the District of Columbia, from
the 1890s to the present.

Each case entry includes: victim/case name, case type, investigation status
(Unsolved, Arrest Made, Conviction, Partially Solved, No Conviction), date,
city and state, victim age and gender, a factual summary, and last-known
information where available.

## Data
- Machine-readable case data: https://coldcaseindex.com/data/cases.json
  (JSON array; one object per case with id, name, type, status, year, date,
  state, city, age, gender, summary, lastSeen, tags)
- Sources include the Murder Accountability Project, FBI UCR data, NamUs,
  court records, law-enforcement releases, and established news reporting.

## URLs
- Homepage (search + filters): https://coldcaseindex.com/
- Individual case pages: https://coldcaseindex.com/cases/{case-id}/
- Cases by state directory: https://coldcaseindex.com/states/
- Per-state pages: https://coldcaseindex.com/states/{state-name}/
- About & methodology: https://coldcaseindex.com/about/
- Privacy policy: https://coldcaseindex.com/privacy/
- Sitemap: https://coldcaseindex.com/sitemap.xml

## Contact
Corrections, updates, or removal requests: info@coldcaseindex.com
If you have information about an unsolved case, contact local law enforcement
or the FBI at 1-800-CALL-FBI (tips.fbi.gov).
